FIELDS.NAME: Precision Tax & Accounting Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Tax & Accounting Services, we specialize in providing individual tax preparation and basic accounting services to individuals and small businesses with straightforward financial needs. Our operations include meticulous tax preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll processing. We ensure compliance with all applicable regulations and maintain the highest professional standards, with all staff members holding relevant certifications. We utilize secure, industry-standard accounting software and enforce strict data security measures to protect our clients' sensitive information. Our services are exclusively domestic, which simplifies the regulatory landscape and enhances our focus on providing quality service. Each client engagement is documented with clear agreements that outline the scope of our services and associated fees, establishing mutual understanding and trust. Furthermore, we conduct regular internal audits of our practices to ensure ongoing compliance and quality control, demonstrating our commitment to excellence in the services we provide.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Accounting Solutions LLC, a small bookkeeping and payroll service catering to local businesses
